nodes.title: Issue #70: RFC Websocket/Channels/PubSub - foundational design
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":98,"prompt":"@chrismccord: 'Really excited to unveil my plans for websocket/pubsub layer. Multiplexed websocket connection with phoenix.js. PubSub layer using :pg2 - we get process groups distributed on the mesh for free. Channels are namespaces for topics. Topics are simply strings.' 22 comments of community feedback."}

nodes.title: Issue #70: @HashNuke - 'vocabulary needs to be simplified'
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@HashNuke: 'Read this as connect to websocket then join multiple channels you want.' @tallakt confused about lobby concept. Chris clarifies: 'Socket is already connected, client asks to join the channel for given topics. join authorizes the socket to subscribe.' Early vocabulary refinement."}

nodes.title: Issue #248: RFC incoming/outgoing channel events
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":90,"prompt":"@chrismccord: 'Todo app needs REST endpoint for creating todos, broadcast todo:created to subscribers, but creator shouldnt receive broadcast. Only way now: client discards for creator. Proposal: rename event/3 to incoming/3, introduce outgoing/3.' 24 comments - real-world use case drives API design."}

nodes.title: Issue #169: José's 'DSL or NoDSL' philosophy applied to mailers
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":90,"prompt":"@josevalim: 'Add DSL for last. You shouldnt require users to use Hermes.Messenger - they should call Hermes.deliver/1 instead. Also we shouldnt provide async APIs, let users do that explicitly so they understand trade-offs.' Links to his Ruby talk 'DSL or NoDSL'. @chrismccord: 'Functions can just be imported instead of generated.'"}

nodes.title: PR #983: Router forward macro (@chrismccord)
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":90,"prompt":"Chris asks José for code review. Allows forwarding requests to other plugs/routers. Enables embedding admin panels, API versioning, and third-party plug integration."}

nodes.title: Issue #489: Host-based routing - subdomain support
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@c-spencer: 'Useful to route on host as well as path for subdomains or multi-site hosting.' @chrismccord shares workaround hack. José proposes: 'host: foo. means starts with, host: foo.bar.com for full match. Should be straightforward.' Shipped in v0.6.1."}

nodes.title: PR #1161: MongoDB support by @michalmuskala
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"Adds binary_id as default in ecto models, MongoDB adapter in installer. Shows Phoenix commitment to being database-agnostic. @michalmuskala later becomes Ecto maintainer."}

nodes.title: PR #517: Phoenix.Endpoint - central configuration point (@josevalim)
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":95,"prompt":"@josevalim introduces Endpoint. Chris on IRC: 'plug :router, MyApp.Router as last plug in Endpoint allows error wrapping and multiple routers.' José: 'we can always revisit.' @lancehalvorsen: 'For umbrella projects, could coordinate across apps.' Major v0.7.0 architectural change."}

nodes.title: PR #485: New error handling with Plug.Debugger (@josevalim)
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":90,"prompt":"Migrates to Plug 0.8.3 with Plug.Debugger. 'Changes code reloader to proxy terminal output to screen in case of compile failure.' Beautiful error pages with code context - one of Phoenix's signature DX features."}

nodes.title: Issue #233: Early Heroku deployment challenges
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":80,"prompt":"@cheeyeo reports ranch.app not found on Heroku deploy. Early production deployment issues - community working through buildpack configuration. Shows real-world adoption challenges in 2014."}

nodes.title: PR #356: before/after_action callbacks (@josevalim)
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":90,"prompt":"José: 'Move to latest Plug, allow controllers in Plug stacks, add before_action/2 and after_action/2 with guards.' Chris: 'This looks fantastic\\! The before/after_action code is particularly clean. I expected way more code\\!' José: 'Merging, will push new router stack tomorrow.' Chris: '❤️💜❤️'"}

nodes.title: PR #329: Router refactor - José's massive first contribution
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":95,"prompt":"@josevalim: 'Uses plug route parsing, optimizes named helpers, refactors around Route struct, allows async tests. Requires Elixir 1.0.' Chris: '1,201 additions and 1,600 deletions - Massive first contribution\\! ❤️❤️❤️' @jeregrine: 'Learning lots reviewing.' Elixir creator goes deep on Phoenix."}

nodes.title: PR #82: @patrickdet adds Travis CI - early quality gates
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"'This way feature branches and all pull requests get tested, which makes it easier to accept pull requests.' CI culture from the start. @patrickdet (Darko Fabijan) - early core contributor."}

nodes.title: Issue #164: Directory structure debate - MVC conventions
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@batwicket: 'Make directory structure consistent with MVC pattern.' Chris: 'We have such a directory today. priv is an Erlang convention for non-source files.' @glesica: 'relationship between views/templates/layouts seems magical.' Chris: 'proper guides can clear this up.' Phoenix keeps templates separate from views - precompiled into Views."}

nodes.title: Issue #204: Conditional plug based on action name
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@chrismccord braindumps: 'Pure Plug approach - Only/Except Plugs or Actions Plug.' José: 'The biggest problem with pure plug is you cannot use it for private functions, and thats a deal breaker.' Shows how José's constraints push API design."}

nodes.title: Issue #402: NewRelic vs Exometer - production monitoring debate
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@mschae: 'Close to putting first phoenix app into production\\!' @thawatchai: 'So far it outperforms the existing node app\\!' @mschae: 'Never got NewRelic to work - secretive wire protocol. I highly recommend Exometer. Remember my ElixirConf claim: you dont want monitoring to take down your app.' Early production war stories."}

nodes.title: PR #1009: SQLite support added by @netantho
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":80,"prompt":"Uses sqlite_ecto. Shows Phoenix commitment to database flexibility - PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite all supported by 1.0."}

nodes.title: PR #1028: UserSocket module generated by default (@chrismccord)
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"Chris asks José: 'Can I get a signoff on the generated module and docs? Should we add comments with more info in UserSocket?' Makes channels more discoverable for new users."}

nodes.title: Issue #459: Request body reading - 61-comment deep dive
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":80,"prompt":"@rylev: 'Need to access body as raw string. Once body consumed, future reads return empty.' Chris provides workaround: 'put_private(conn, :my_app_body, read_body(conn)) in :before pipeline.' 61 comments - shows complexity of body handling."}

nodes.title: Issue #1165: Vim/Syntastic code reload race condition
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@christopherslee: 'Server not reloading code.' Chris nails it: 'What editor? Syntastic causes issues - checks for syntax errors and messes with ctime/mtime.' The plugin recompiles behind scenes, so when request comes in, mix sees files already compiled. Years of workarounds documented."}

nodes.title: Issue #1054: Content negotiation - pipelines vs format checking
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"@FND: 'Not possible to perform standard content negotiation without compromising.' Chris: 'You could create a plug that dispatches based on accept header.' José: 'Dont mix pipelines with content negotiation. Make things conditional on format inside the pipeline.' Simple > Complex."}

nodes.title: Issue #861: Session in tests - @valo discovers init_test_session
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":80,"prompt":"@crismali confused about session in tests. @gjaldon: 'Call get/2 first, then session functions work.' @valo finds better solution: 'Use Plug.Test.init_test_session/2' - 51 thumbs up. José: 'init_test_session was added to Plug later :D'"}

nodes.title: Issue #534: phoenix.start => phoenix.server - OTP norms
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":90,"prompt":"@chrismccord after IRC with @josevalim, @fishcakez, @drewolson: 'Need to rethink phoenix.start. It could lead towards bad practices. Phoenix goal is integrate nicely with your greater OTP app. Rename to phoenix.server for dev only. Teach best practices early, but also make it easy to get started.'"}

nodes.title: PR #598: Singular resource routing by @joshnuss
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"Adds 'resource /session, SessionController' - routes without index or ID params. Perfect for current user session, profile, settings. Later becomes 'resources with singleton: true' option."}

nodes.title: PR #442: Rendering/layouts improvements (@josevalim)
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":95,"prompt":"Implementation of #359.
